lines.speaker: Homeroom Teacher
lines.text: Hold on — just a moment everyone.

lines.speaker: Homeroom Teacher
lines.text: If you’re serious about applying for a scholarship, start thinking about how to make your application stand out.

lines.speaker: Homeroom Teacher
lines.text: There’s a volunteering program after school.If you help out three times this week, you will receive a recommendation letter from them.

lines.speaker: Homeroom Teacher
lines.text: And one more thing — if you want me to look over your CV or motivation letter before handing them in, I’m available. Just don’t drop them on my desk the day before the deadline.
